BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

10. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
